newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CLOSING: HOIU ACTIVE, FARMA GAINS.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CLOSING: HOIU ACTIVE, FARMA GAINS.

text.p: * Preliminary data from the Estonian bourse on Wednesday
put total trade at 55.2 million kroons versus 38.05 million
* Early data shows Hoiupank was the most active
stock in trade of 19.2 million kroons to close 0.60 kroons
* Farmaatsiatehas gained the most to close 4.25
kroons higher at 117.05 kroons with a volume of 10.8 million
kroons lower at 130.75 kroons with a volume of 3.3 million
